prompt: Our cucumbers wilt around noon on sunny summer days. We open the roof vents wide once the greenhouse reaches 24 C and we dose CO2. Leaves feel warm to the touch and RH drops to about 50%. Should we put on whitewash or close the shade screen?
assertions: Warns that shading/whitewash cuts photosynthesis and can start a negative spiral, and advises trying humidity and water-supply measures first
Recommends ventilating less / allowing a higher temperature (e.g. 26-28 C) to keep humidity and CO2 inside on sunny days
Explains that evaporation is driven by absorbed energy (radiation) rather than by low RH, and that warm leaves indicate closing stomata / water stress
Recommends measuring leaf temperature and/or VPD, with roughly 0.3-1.5 kPa as healthy and above ~1.5 kPa as stress
Addresses water supply or root uptake (e.g. irrigation based on radiation, ramping up in the morning, root health)
Mentions misting or another way to raise RH under high radiation, and/or the CO2 lost through wide-open vents
